items.label: Eversource Q2 FY2026 (07-30-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Reaffirmed 2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance of $4.52 to $4.72 per share

set.signal: Reaffirmed 2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance of $4.52 to $4.72 per share (revised in March for the 9.57% base transmission ROE and the Aquarion sale) and long-term EPS growth of 5% to 7%, with management pointing to the upper half of that range and growth accelerating around 2028. The $4.52 lower bound is as spoken on the call; the filed release and slides print a different lower bound (see the Eversource 8-K entry). Management declined to publish a separate rate base growth target, noting historical rate base growth has been slightly over an 8% CAGR and can be derived from the capital slides.

items.signal_prefix: Reaffirmed the five-year capital plan of $21.5 billion

set.signal: Reaffirmed the five-year capital plan of $21.5 billion of utility infrastructure investment by segment. For the first time the company highlighted the potential increase to that capital forecast from the ISO New England preliminary transmission RFP selection and from AMI in Connecticut - neither is inside the $21.5 billion yet. This is the grid transmission and distribution spend that drives Eversource's transformer, substation and line-equipment procurement. The $21.5 billion is as spoken on the call; the filed slides for the same plan print a different total and horizon (see the Eversource 8-K entry).
